groups.name: server.netty
groups.description: Configuration properties for the Netty-based web server that replaces Tomcat in this starter.

properties.name: server.netty.boss-threads
properties.description: Size of the event-loop group that accepts connections. Defaults to 1. See https://github.com/azholdaspaev/netty-loom-spring/blob/main/docs/configuration.md#servernetty

properties.name: server.netty.worker-threads
properties.description: Size of the event-loop group that reads and writes on accepted connections. Defaults to 0. See https://github.com/azholdaspaev/netty-loom-spring/blob/main/docs/configuration.md#servernetty

properties.name: server.netty.tcp-keep-alive
properties.description: Socket-level SO_KEEPALIVE on accepted connections. Defaults to true. See https://github.com/azholdaspaev/netty-loom-spring/blob/main/docs/configuration.md#servernetty

properties.name: server.netty.shutdown-grace-period
properties.description: How long graceful shutdown drains before force-closing. Defaults to 30s. See https://github.com/azholdaspaev/netty-loom-spring/blob/main/docs/configuration.md#servernetty

properties.name: server.netty.read-timeout
properties.description: The slow-loris deadline, measured on the client rather than on your handler. Defaults to 30s. See https://github.com/azholdaspaev/netty-loom-spring/blob/main/docs/configuration.md#servernetty

properties.name: server.netty.write-stall-timeout
properties.description: How long a response waits on a client that has stopped reading it. Defaults to 60s. See https://github.com/azholdaspaev/netty-loom-spring/blob/main/docs/configuration.md#servernetty

properties.name: server.netty.max-http-body-size
properties.description: Request body cap, answered 413. Defaults to 1MB. See https://github.com/azholdaspaev/netty-loom-spring/blob/main/docs/configuration.md#servernetty

properties.name: server.netty.max-header-size
properties.description: Request header-block cap, answered 431. Defaults to 10000B. See https://github.com/azholdaspaev/netty-loom-spring/blob/main/docs/configuration.md#servernetty

properties.name: server.netty.max-initial-line-length
properties.description: Request-line cap, answered 414. Defaults to 10000B. See https://github.com/azholdaspaev/netty-loom-spring/blob/main/docs/configuration.md#servernetty

properties.name: server.netty.max-chunk-size
properties.description: Size of the pieces a request body is delivered in. Defaults to 10000B. See https://github.com/azholdaspaev/netty-loom-spring/blob/main/docs/configuration.md#servernetty

properties.name: server.netty.transport
properties.description: Netty I/O transport: auto, nio, epoll or kqueue. Defaults to auto. See https://github.com/azholdaspaev/netty-loom-spring/blob/main/docs/configuration.md#servernetty

values.description: Not a default. Passed to listen() verbatim on epoll and kqueue (a queue of at most one pending connection on Linux); the nio transport substitutes 50. Tomcat would keep 100.
Disable the read timeout entirely; connections are never closed for client inactivity.
Any negative value also disables the read timeout.
